stopping.rule: First checkpoint >=30 where both fixed halves of both A and B complete >=0.8 of their contemporaneous cores at both 0 and 60 seconds. C and all other gates are excluded.
stopping.core: At least 80% presence in the last ten trials of that cue.
stopping.noMatch: Evaluate epoch 80, mark criterion not reached and fail.
stopping.afterStop: Continue the same training to epoch 80 for the curve only. Never replace the first stopping circuit after seeing another gate fail.

controls.training: Match each primary stopping epoch. Controls do not choose their own duration; untrained has zero epochs.
controls.pruning: Prune only growth-formed pool-to-pool edges on the circuit at the primary stopping epoch.
controls.required: Growth-off fails 9 and 10; Hebbian-off fails 9 and 10; prune-formed lowers every A/B half at both delays below 0.6 from a higher value.

acceptance.completion: Both halves of A/B at both delays >=0.8 AND gain >=0.25 over untrained on the same contemporaneous core.
acceptance.negativeCue: Readback rejects C at both delays, C-to-core Jaccards <=0.25, spillover <=25% of the smaller core.
acceptance.decision: All three baseline seeds reach criterion and pass every gate and required control at their own stop. The comparison is reported only.

checkpointProbes.isolation: Independent locked native controllers. No probe or stopping decision changes formation state or RNG.

1-stability.rule: Both last-ten-trial mean pairwise Jaccards >= 0.7; strict >= 0.8 reported separately.

2-specificity.rule: Inter-core Jaccard <= 0.2; size is evaluated separately.

4-negative-cue.rule: At both idle durations: nearest-core readback rejects C (< 0.5), C-to-each-core Jaccard <= 0.25, and spillover outside directSet(C) <= 25% of the smaller core.

5-compactness.rule: Observation: each core distance / matched random-subset distance < 0.8; not a Stage 1f gate.

6-recruitment.rule: Observation: at least 30% of each core is outside both trained cues' initial direct sets; not a Stage 1f gate.

7-recurrent-structure.rule: Each core has >= its size surviving growth-formed internal edges, and internal directed density >= 3 times the pool-wide directed density.

8-retention.rule: Locked A probe after 60 seconds has Jaccard >= 0.8 with core A; B also reported.

9-pattern-completion.rule: For A and B, both fixed halves at both delays: completion >= 0.8 and improvement over the untrained circuit on the same core >= 0.25.

10-potentiation.rule: Each core: median surviving within-core formed weight >= 0.6. Ignition fraction is reported, not gated.
